text:
alex: Heads-up — Node SDK + JSON mode weirdness with toolcall responses. My sample app suddenly started failing schema validation because the tool output came back as an array instead of the object we expect. Anyone seen this?

maria: Ugh yes, ran into this yesterday in the onboarding sample. Python SDK coerces a single-item array into an object in JSON mode; Node leaves it as an array, so our schema -> validator blows up.

alex: Minimal repro (Node):
```js
const res = await client.callTool('fetch_items', {q:'foo'}, {json: true});
// res.tool_output -> [ { id: 'abc', value: {...} } ]
// our schema expects { item: {...} } and fails parse
```

sam: Can you paste logs from the auth/retry path? We had a bug where the retry wrapper double-encodes / returns raw string on replay.

alex: log snippet:
```
INFO replaying request after 401 refresh
DEBUG raw_response: "[ {\"id\":\"abc\", \"value\": {...} } ]"
ERROR schema-validator: expected OBJECT but got ARRAY
```

jin: Looks like the normalize helper runs only on the happy path. If retry returns the raw string it bypasses the helper and we don't coerce. So the Node path ends up with an array string -> parsed into array.

maria: Workaround for now: tiny ensureObject util in sample app: `if (Array.isArray(x) && x.length===1) x = x[0];` but that's gross.

sam: We should decide: 1) make Node mimic Python coercion, or 2) make SDK strict and require platform to always return object. Which is less surprising?

alex: Per spec JSON mode should return the parsed JSON AST. For tool/function calling, the SDK should provide deterministic normalization. I favor SDK parity across languages (coerce single-item arrays for toolcall outputs).

dev-bot: Issue created: INF-4821 "node sdk toolcall jsonmode array-vs-object inconsistency" assigned to eng-devex

maria: Note: this only repros when auth retry triggers (401 -> refresh -> replay). If the call succeeds first try Node returns object. So the replay path is the bug.

sam: Proposal: after replay, parse the body and run the same normalizeToolOutput() helper before handing to higher layers. Add unit test for replay path. Also add an e2e in sample-app to catch this. cc @eng-ml for evaluation regression checks.

jin: I'll spike a PR. Quick patch: if content-type is application/json and body startsWith '[' && expectedSchemaType==='object' then coerce array-of-one -> object (only in SDK helper). But I agree we should avoid heuristics long-term.

alex: Alternative approach: expose an SDK option `normalizeToolOutput: 'strict'|'lenient'` (default 'strict'). For onboarding we can default to 'lenient' for the starter kit, but keep strict parity for prod.

maria: +1. Also add a docs note in the sample-app troubleshooting about JSON mode and auth/retry interactions so customers aren't blocked.

sam: I'll add the e2e and the starter-kit guard message: if validator error shows EXPECTED_OBJECT_BUT_GOT_ARRAY then include "tip: try updating SDK or set normalizeToolOutput to lenient".

alex: Thanks team. Jin, please link PR to INF-4821 and mark for next patch release.

dev-bot: INF-4821 updated: labels [bug, sdk-node, jsonmode, retry]
